name: Probability density evolution method (PDEM)
definition_zh: 通过概率密度随动力过程的演化研究随机响应分布的方法。
definition_en: A method that tracks the evolution of probability density in stochastic dynamical systems using probability conservation.
usage_overview: 基于概率守恒，利用动力响应轨迹将随机输入的概率信息传递到随时间变化的响应概率密度，连接确定性动力计算与随机响应评价。在车辆—轨道等耦合系统中，用于分析随机激励下的响应分布，也用作其他随机分析方法的比较基准。

complete_examples.text: Furthermore, by introducing the probability density evolution method (PDEM), the probabilistic transmission between track irregularities and system responses is properly solved, which is presented in Section 5 .
Finally, a probability density evolution method (PDEM) is introduced to solve the probabilistic transmission issue between track random irregularities and dynamic responses.

In addition, the vehicle–track coupled model, probability density evolution method (PDEM) and random process theory are modelled and introduced for obtaining the dynamic responses and capturing the probabilistic transmission between track random irregularities and dynamic responses.

Finally, a probability density evolution method (PDEM) is introduced to solve the probabilistic transmission issues between track irregularity sets and dynamic responses of vehicle–track coupled systems.

Luckily, starting with the idea of evolution of probability densities, a probability density evolution method (PDEM) aimed at capturing the flow trajectories of probabilities for linear/nonlinear stochastic systems has been developed by Li and Chen [31], and a series of applications can be found in [32].

Secondly, a vehicle-track coupled model that properly considers the wheel-rail nonlinear contacts and the excitations of seismic waves is developed, in which a probability density evolution method (PDEM) [23] is introduced to solve the probabilistic transmission between excitation inputs and response outputs.

The probability density evolution method (PDEM) proposed by Li and Chen [23] is capable of capturing the instantaneous probability transmission, which has provided new perspectives to tackle stochastic vibration based issues.

To assess the dynamic performance of a railway system in more comprehensive and practical ways, a framework for probabilistic assessment of vehicle-curved track systems is developed by effectively integrating a vehicle–track coupled model (VTCM), a track irregularity probabilistic model (TIPM) with a probability density evolution method (PDEM).
The stochastic fractional derivative model is based on the Gru ̈nwald representation of fractional calculus, the number theoretical method, and the probability density evolution method (PDEM).

In this regard, a stochastic fractional derivative (SFD) model is proposed in this work based on Gru ̈ nwald representation of fractional calculus, the number theoretical method (NTM), and the probability density evolution method (PDEM).
